content.text: 3.1 Encontre os phrasal verbs e diga o sentido
I need to look for my keys.
She gave up smoking last year.
Can you pick me up at 7?
He came back from Chicago yesterday.
Put on your jacket — it's cold.

questions.questionText: In “Can you pick me up at 7?”, “pick up” means…

explanations.general: Correct answer: collect me (in a car)

questions.questionText: He came ______ from Chicago yesterday. (voltou — partícula)

content.text: o professor lê um mini texto com 8 phrasal verbs. O aluno identifica cada um e diz o sentido pelo contexto.

“This morning I woke up late. I got up, put on my clothes and looked for my phone. Then I found out my train was canceled, so I called my sister and she picked me up. I almost gave up, but I got to work on time.”
What time do you wake up? What have you given up? What do you usually look for and never find? Who picks you up when you need a ride?
